decisions.reason: The electronic church music box extends an established line at low incremental cost, and with only one season of evidence its value is still uncertain, so keeping the option open is cheap and sensible.
A wooden nativity stable is a core seasonal item that uses existing workshop skills and has steady demand, so the cost of keeping it is minimal and nothing yet suggests abandoning it.

The modern incense smoker tests the firm's move toward contemporary design, its demand is still uncertain after one season, and its holding cost in small-batch handcraft is low, so management keeps it to learn more before committing or dropping.
